title: Minimum-Cost Network Flow with Dual Predictions
one_line_en: First minimum-cost flow algorithm warm-started by a learned dual prediction: epsilon-relaxation runs in O(min{n^3 log||p_hat - p*||_inf, n^3 log(nC)}) (Theorem 2), consistent and robust, with PAC bounds for learning the prediction and 12.7x / 1.6x speedups on traffic and PCB routing.
one_line_zh: 第一个用学到的对偶预测热启动的最小费用流算法：ε-relaxation 的时间变为 O(min{n^3 log||p_hat-p*||_inf, n^3 log(nC)})（Theorem 2），预测越准越快、全错也不差于经典；O08 的对偶势可直接充当这里的预测。
